uses.test: evaluation only: CIs, registered policies against each other, and the P60 routing ablation; no threshold, policy or setting was changed
uses.confirm: 300 questions for the latency run only (no scoring)

test_p3_rows: rebuilt by `final_evaluation.py rows` from the local raw Test candidates and the archived generations; the release test rebuilds them when the raw files exist

judge.scope: P3-20 and BM25-rule answers on unrouted Test items that no earlier batch labelled

latency_run.path: pipeline.run, one question at a time after 10 warm-up questions
latency_run.code: server copy code_adaptive (the code of the confirm equivalence run)
latency_run.sample: confirm IDs ordered by sha256("latency_v1_20261031::" + id): 10 warm-up, next 300 timed
latency_run.data_boundary: questions only on the GPU host
